validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE and CLASSIFICATION are both solidly confirmed: ural-kraeved.ru's Nizhnetury LPUMG chronicle names this exact segment 'Нижняя Тура-Пермь-3' and dates its commissioning to 1979, matching the sheet's StartYear1 exactly; ru.wikipedia's system history independently corroborates that the Nizhnyaya Tura-Perm section carries THREE strings (nitki) and that the system was 'finally commissioned' in 1979 -- consistent with this being the third and final string. Classified correctly as a Gazprom-operated transmission (магистральный) trunk. HOWEVER: the state audit (batches/russia-gas/staging/state-audit-20260914/region_audit.csv) flags this row START_MISMATCH -- its stored route geometry runs Perm Krai -> Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, i.e. the SAME geometry class as sibling rows P5715/P5716 (Perm-Gorky), not the Nizhnyaya Tura(Sverdlovsk Oblast)->Perm Krai route this row's own StartLocation/EndLocation cells and every independent source describe. This looks like a geometry mix-up between the NT-Perm leg and the Perm-Gorky leg of the same overall corridor, not a duplicate-entity or non-existence problem. RouteAccuracy is currently 'high' (Mapped route at any accuracy), which is wrong given the mismatch; it should not be pasted over without a correct NT-Perm geometry.
